sn37.5:1.1: atha kho āyasmā anuruddho yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā anuruddho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn37.5:1.2: idhāhaṃ bhante mātugāmaṃ passāmi dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjantaṃ.
sn37.5:1.3: katīhi nu kho bhante dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjatīti.
sn37.5:2.1: pañcahi kho anuruddha dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
sn37.5:2.3: assaddho ca hoti ahiriko ca hoti anottappī ca hoti kodhano ca hoti duppañño ca hoti.
sn37.5:2.4: imehi kho anuruddha pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjatīti.
